title: Additional Cast for 'Shuiro no Kamen' Announced
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's Shuiro no Kamen ( The Vermilion Mask ) manga announced five additional cast members on Friday. The anime series began airing on October 10 at 5:30 p.m. on Yomiuri TV and Nippon TV, with the second part will air in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Hinagiku no Jinsei' Announces Additional Staff, 2027 Delays
content: Animation studio ame pippin revealed additional staff members and still images (pictured) for the anime movie adaptation of Banana Yoshimoto 's Hinagiku no Jinsei ( Daisy's Life ) novel on Friday. The anime, previously scheduled for 2026, is now planned for a 2027 opening.
author: MyAnimeList

title: A Fantasy Epic Just Confirmed Its 2027 Launch & Anime Fans Should Take Notice
content: A new anime just confirmed its 2027 release window, and action fantasy fans must add it to their watchlist. 2026 is almost finally its end, which is why the next year’s lineup is revealing all the major information fans can expect.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer Will Never Top Its Biggest Hashira Fight
content: Each season and movie of Demon Slayer has been exceptional without a doubt, but there’s a reason why Mugen Train stands out as the best among them. The anime premiered in 2019, and only a year later, it released its first canon movie to continue Tanjiro’s journey.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Great Shonen Jump Manga Ended in 2026
content: When it comes to Shonen action and drama, Weekly Shonen Jump always grabs the spotlight, and this has been the case for many decades now. Established in 1968, it eventually became the best-selling manga magazine of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Is Hurting the Anime More Than Helping
content: Dragon Ball Super : Beerus is a huge disappointment after the Battle of Gods arc, which featured the main battle between Goku and Beerus. The anime returned this month as part of the Fall 2026 lineup, but instead of continuing the story with a sequel, Toei Animation released a remake version of the previous arcs.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action This World is Worth Fighting For Series Casts Ikoi Hayase
content: The official website for the live-action series of Hatsumi Kodama 's This World is Worth Fighting For ( Konoyo wa Tatakau Kachi ga Aru ) manga announced on Friday that Ikoi Hayase (live-action Journal with Witch /Worlds Apart, Cursed Meme, Ano Ko wa Daare?) is joining the series' cast.
author: ANN

title: No Longer Heroine's Momoko Kōda Launches New Manga on December 21
content: Manga creator Momoko Kōda announced on November 20 that they will launch a new manga titled Kono Oto, Myaku Ari Desu ka? (Is This Sound a Pulse of Interest?) on Shueisha 's Manga Mee web platform on December 21.
author: ANN

title: Isekai Affair Writer Masakazu Ooi Launches New Manga
content: Shogakukan 's online magazine Weekly CoroCoro Comic launched Masakazu Ooi 's new manga Ma Mama Musō~Maō no Mama ni Amae Makuttara Saikyō ni! Saijaku Skill "Amaenbō" de Musōshite Akugyaku Yūsha ni Fukushūshimasu (Ma Mama Musō: Becoming the Strongest by Being Utterly Pampered by the Demon Lord's Mama!
author: ANN

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Creator Breaks Silence on Future Projects: “I’m Working on Something You Don’t Really Want”
content: The franchise’s co-creator Bryan Konietzko drops a major hint regarding future projects. The fan-favorite Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise keeps expanding as the latest animated series was released after 12 years to explore the unique worldbuilding and the captivating characters.
author: ComicBook
